title: Gray Ribbed Hoodie & Studded Flares
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark hair stands full-length against a white backdrop. She wears a fitted gray ribbed zip hoodie with a V-neck and flap pockets, with small star-shaped metal accents at the waist. Black flared trousers have rows of silver eyelets and long straps down the legs, with a fur-trimmed pouch at one hip. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light. Palette of heathered gray, black, and silver. Edgy and structured, in the style of a Y2K streetwear lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The studded flares and straps are the defining details.
- Add 'full-length, head to toe' to keep the shoes in frame.
tryThis: Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the shoes.
